name: upli_receive_channel
description: Common 2.6/4.3 per-account SRAM receive storage and initial/normal credit handoff; not TL transaction or burst validation.

design_requirements.confirmation_notes: User authorized complete UALink digital IP using local Verilator/Yosys/OpenSTA and authorized external SRAM models. This planned internal block retains native no-ready ingress and adds no on-wire fields.

behavior: Ports 1/2/4, five accounts per port, capacities0..65535 constrained by credit width3..16; exact FIFO capacity is the sole source of initial credit parameters.
Word low bits are payload, original VC2, Pool1, then zero byte padding; no added UPLI fields. Zero-capacity accounts instantiate no SRAM.
Retirement requires real cached head, consumer readiness and old return-queue readiness simultaneously; original metadata is retained atomically.

Normal credit reservation uses pre-edge per-port init_done and return-direction connection. Registered initial and normal outputs are mutually exclusive per port and merged without another register or cancel mux.
Diagnostic0 none,1 inactive port,2 not connected,3 not initialized,4 no old capacity; these local codes do not define protocol RAS or recovery.
All connection levels stay asserted until synchronous interface reset; this single-domain component assumes legal connection-controller outputs.
constraints: All RTL-MD MUST rules apply. Native UPLI and project snake_case plus short bilingual headers override AXI/template preferences.
Authored Verilog-2001 uses Chinese same-line semantic comments and one register per clocked always; external SRAM source is read-only and not restyled.
0.640/6.400ns are unchanged target periods, not a claim of channel-level STA completion. Prior storage component budgets do not sign off this channel.
notes: Integer interface widths describe ports1/payload32/credit4/return-depth4; parameter-derived widths apply to other configurations.
The TB separately uses a real sender bank and independent payload/credit journals; direct illegal injections are not legal bank sends.
Formal observation wrapper proves selected channel control ownership with arbitrary macro Q. It is verification-only, not a synthesizable product top or a memory-content proof.

The separate channel content checker and read-only word invariant retain actual SDP memory, compare original accepted words and retired VC/Pool to independent queues; only finite exercised configurations are claimed. Neither checker is product RTL.
No complete UPLI, TL/DL/PHY, CDC/RDC, actual SRAM macro or full-IP physical signoff is claimed.
